mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% triggers monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.0% when expected, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite both proxies rising (t-test p > 0.05) or correlation between proxies < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 3.5% signals labor market tightness, raising inflation expectations and causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 3.5% threshold or 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL rising) erodes real returns on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not rise or 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low demand (HOUST) and low FEDFUNDS (easing) create favorable conditions for equity growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive despite both proxies being low or weak correlation between proxies.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion', a drop in RSAFS (demand) signals weakening demand momentum, yet S&P 500 forward returns remain positive over the next 20 trading days due to broader market optimism.
failure_condition: RSAFS does not drop in the 'late-cycle expansion' regime or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (labor) crosses above 1.6M, indicating strong job growth, high expectations for inflation and interest rate hikes lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 1.6M threshold or 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
